tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: the conversation, the session workspace, dialogs.

tokens.name: bg-pane
tokens.usage: Rail, header, the left list with filters and grouping, inspector, cards. Every text pair is checked on it.

tokens.name: bg-raise
tokens.usage: Button and input fill; raised cards inside a pane.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Row and rail hover.

tokens.name: bg-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: code blocks, quoted tool output, empty slots.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text and row titles on bg, bg-pane and bg-raise.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text that still reads as content: quiet button labels, chip text, footer links.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata: ages, hosts, one-line summaries, section labels. 4.5:1 on bg-pane in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panes and rows. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Resting border of buttons, inputs and kbd hints. Kept from the shipped app: about 1.5:1 on bg-pane, below the 3:1 for control edges, so a control is also told apart by its bg-raise fill and its label. Use accent for any border that carries state.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action, selection, links, focus. Never a status.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text on a filled accent button.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row and rail item, AI suggestion pill, drag-over tint.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 1px offset, on every focusable element.

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: A turn is running. Text-safe on bg and bg-pane.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Needs you: a question, a permission, a push to approve, a grant to sign. The attention colour; nothing else is amber.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Failed, stuck, CI red, a blocked verdict.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Completed turn, CI green, PR ready or merged, a check that passed.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Idle, paused, stopped, queued. Never used for something that needs action.

tokens.name: on-waiting
tokens.usage: Text on a filled status-waiting badge (the Inbox count on the rail).

tokens.name: waiting-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a Waiting or Needs you chip.

tokens.name: waiting-faint
tokens.usage: Fill of a waiting banner or a question card.

tokens.name: waiting-line
tokens.usage: Border of a waiting banner or question card.

tokens.name: failed-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a Failed chip and failed banner.

tokens.name: failed-line
tokens.usage: Border of a failed banner.

tokens.name: done-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a Done chip.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid field borders, quiet destructive buttons.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the one destructive confirm button in a dialog (Kill, Delete).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-fill.

tokens.name: chip-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral chip fill: host, PR, filter chips.

tokens.name: count-bg
tokens.usage: Count pill beside a section header or filter button.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a meter (context, quota, progress).

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: Inline code and paths inside prose.

tokens.name: syn-kw
tokens.usage: Code viewer: keywords.

tokens.name: syn-str
tokens.usage: Code viewer: strings.

tokens.name: syn-num
tokens.usage: Code viewer: numbers. Light value darkened from the shipped #b76b01 so it holds 4.5:1 on bg-pane (5.5:1), bg (5.1:1) and the bg-sunk code well (4.9:1).

tokens.name: org-1
tokens.usage: First organisation swatch (scope chip, row swatch).

tokens.name: org-2
tokens.usage: Second organisation swatch.

tokens.name: org-3
tokens.usage: Third organisation swatch.

tokens.name: org-4
tokens.usage: Fourth organisation swatch; personal or no org.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The Orbit tile. Logo, loaders and the splash only; never UI chrome.

tokens.name: brand-light
tokens.usage: Hub, ring and hosts on the brand-ink tile.

tokens.name: brand-amber
tokens.usage: The one waiting host in the mark, and the lead particle in loaders. Same hue as dark status-waiting by design.

tokens.name: loader-accent
tokens.usage: Accent particles inside a loader stage, which is dark in both themes.

tokens.name: comet-head
tokens.usage: Bright head of the Comet loader inside buttons and rows.

tokens.name: agent-claude
tokens.usage: The Claude Code agent tab icon only. Other agents get their own mark.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal dialog: dims the app so the dialog reads as the one thing to answer.

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: The tour: dims everything but the lit spot.

tokens.name: ai-pre
tokens.usage: Mark on text Claude wrote before the person accepts it.

tokens.name: usage-ok
tokens.usage: Account usage bar under its limit.

tokens.name: usage-warn
tokens.usage: Account usage bar near its limit.

tokens.name: usage-crit
tokens.usage: Account usage bar at its limit.

tokens.name: syn-code
tokens.usage: Inline code in syntax-highlighted blocks.

tokens.name: control-bg
tokens.usage: Settings and form controls: fill.

tokens.name: control-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Settings and form controls: fill on hover.

tokens.name: control-bg-active
tokens.usage: Settings and form controls: fill while pressed or on.

tokens.name: control-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control edge that has to clear 3:1 on its own (checkbox, radio, switch track).

tokens.name: control-fg

tokens.name: control-fg-quiet
tokens.usage: Settings and form controls: secondary text, units.

styles.name: text-xl
styles.usage: Page titles in Settings and Control's greeting.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Terminals, diffs, tool calls, branch names, paths.

aliases.name: mono

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; gap inside a chip row.

tokens.usage: Row gutter, gap between buttons.

tokens.usage: Pane side padding; row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: settings-nav-w

tokens.name: prose-max

tokens.name: status-h

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Loader stages, toasts, large frames.

tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus.

tokens.name: dur-slow

tokens.name: loader-delay
tokens.usage: A wait shorter than this shows no loader at all.

tokens.name: loader-reduced
tokens.usage: With reduced motion every loader loop becomes one opacity fade of this length.

tokens.name: hub-lost-after
